c1-chain.title: Chaining Clauses
c1-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + و/بس + نتيجة (verb + because + reason + and/but + result)
c1-chain.explanation: At this level, sentences stop being single statements and start chaining reason and result together: بشوف بيت جديد اليوم لأن هاد قديم كتير، وعندي فلوس منيح (I'm seeing a new house today because this one is very old, and I have good money). Each clause stays simple -- the skill is stringing 2-3 of them together fluently, the way real spoken Syrian Arabic naturally runs on.
c1-chain.fact: Long chained sentences like this are exactly how Syrian Arabic speakers naturally tell a story or explain a decision out loud -- rarely as one flat statement, almost always as a little chain of "this, because that, so this."

items.ar: ما منشوف بيت الأهل اليوم مش لأن تعبانين، بس لأن السيارة مشكلة
items.en: We're not seeing the family's house today not because we're tired, but because the car is a problem
items.translit: ma mnshuf beit el-ahl el-yom mish la2an ta3baaneen, bas la2an es-sayyara mushkile

items.ar: صباح الخير، بحب القهوة منيح، وبعدين بشوف بيت لأن عندي شي كتير
items.en: Good morning, I love the good coffee, and then I see a house because I have a lot to do
items.translit: sabah el-kheir, b7ibb el-ahwe mnih, wa ba3dein bshuf beit la2an 3andi shi kteer

items.ar: شفت بيت الأهل مبارح لأن ما شفته كتير، وبحب القهوة منيح معهن
items.en: I saw the family's house yesterday because I hadn't seen it much, and I love the coffee with them, good
items.translit: shift beit el-ahl mbare7 la2an ma shifto kteer, wa b7ibb el-ahwe mnih ma3hon

items.ar: عندي فلوس منيح اليوم لأن ما شفت البيت الغالي، وبدي بشوف بكرة
items.en: I have good money today because I didn't see the expensive house, and I want to see one tomorrow
items.translit: 3andi fluus mnih el-yom la2an ma shift el-beit el-ghali, wa biddi bshuf bukra

items.ar: صباح النور، أنا منيح اليوم لأن عندي أهل منيح، وشفتهن اليوم
items.en: Good morning, I'm good today because I have a good family, and I saw them today
items.translit: sabah en-noor, ana mnih el-yom la2an 3andi ahl mnih, wa shifthon el-yom

items.ar: بدي بشوف بيت اليوم لأن هاد قديم كتير، وعندي فلوس منيح اليوم
items.en: I want to see a house today because this one is very old, and I have good money today
items.translit: biddi bshuf beit el-yom la2an haad adeem kteer, wa 3andi fluus mnih el-yom

items.ar: بتحب القهوة اليوم لأن تعبانة كتير، بس عندك شي كتير بعدين
items.en: You love the coffee today because you're very tired, but you have something later
items.translit: bt7ibb el-ahwe el-yom la2an ta3baane kteer, bas 3andek shi kteer ba3dein

items.ar: بيشوف بيت جديد اليوم لأن عنده فلوس منيح، وبيحب البيت الأخضر كتير
items.en: He's seeing a new house today because he has good money, and he loves the green house a lot
items.translit: byshuf beit jdeed el-yom la2an 3ando fluus mnih, wa by7ibb el-beit el-akhdar kteer

items.ar: منشوف بيت الأهل اليوم لأن ما شفناه كتير، ومنحب القهوة معهن منيح
items.en: We're seeing the family's house today because we haven't seen it much, and we love the coffee with them, good
items.translit: mnshuf beit el-ahl el-yom la2an ma shifnah kteer, wa mn7ibb el-ahwe ma3hon mnih

items.ar: عندي تلاتة فلوس منيح اليوم لأن عندي شي منيح، وبدي بشوف بيت بعدين
items.en: I have three good [money] today because I have something good, and I want to see a house later
items.translit: 3andi tlete fluus mnih el-yom la2an 3andi shi mnih, wa biddi bshuf beit ba3dein

items.ar: ما بشوف بيت اليوم مش لأن تعبان، بس لأن ما عندي فلوس كتير
items.en: I'm not seeing a house today not because I'm tired, but because I don't have a lot of money
items.translit: ma bshuf beit el-yom mish la2an ta3baan, bas la2an ma 3andi fluus kteer

items.ar: صباح الخير، بحب القهوة منيح، وبعدين بشوف بيت لأن عندي شي كتير
items.en: Good morning, I love the good coffee, and then I see a house because I have a lot to do
items.translit: sabah el-kheir, b7ibb el-ahwe mnih, wa ba3dein bshuf beit la2an 3andi shi kteer

items.en: I have good money today because I didn't see the expensive house, and I want to see one tomorrow
